content.short: We are a generative NFT project bridging together community and creation, with a little magic at hand.
content.description:
We are creating a project that puts the community first, by not only rewarding holders with airdrops, but also a community governed wallet.

We hope that not only this can be used for utility for our project, but also build a launchpad for new creators/projects in the space by utilizing our Cauldron Featured panel!

With 3 series in Chapter 1, Wize Wizards (series 1), Wize Potions (series 2) and Morphed Wizards (series 3) we want to portray how folklore can be incorporated with art in an NFT project!
